The cached step searched for '[data-testid=\'input-lastname\']' and 'Last Name *', but the failure screenshot shows 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *' instead.
The page renders cleanly with zero console or network errors, confirming the application is functioning properly.
The overall objective is semantically flexible and easily achievable autonomously.
